title: Ravens have become the ultimate good half/bad half team

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens have become the ultimate good half/bad half team
sources.description: The Baltimore Ravens have fallen from 4-1 to 4-3, thanks to a pair of division games in which a 10-0 halftime lead against the Browns became a loss and a 13-0 halftime lead against the Bengals became a loss.
